//: ETicketsGo organizer web (Next.js standalone). Root Directory stays '/'. NO migrations here. NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL is a BUILD-TIME variable inlined into the bundle — set it on this service before the first build; changing it requires a rebuild. Also set STRIPE_CONNECT_RETURN_URL / STRIPE_CONNECT_REFRESH_URL on the API service to this app's public hostname so organizer payout onboarding returns to the right environment. /api/health is a static Next route handler.
